questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Cobras or Dolphins?
At which ground did Iinyathi record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Khaya Majola Oval — largest win by runs of 129, against Kei on 2019/10/27.

questions.question: "Warriors" is the current name for which former provincial union?
At which ground did Tumi Sekhukhune record their career-best innings (63*, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Willowmoore Park Main Oval, against Rhinos on 2016/01/23.

questions.question: At Polokwane Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Wickets' (T20)?
Who holds the record for 'Most Wickets' in the 15/16 season (List A)?
questions.explanation: Yolandi Potgieter holds it, with a total of 19.
